_comment: Advisories scripts/ci/audit.sh pnpm may ignore. Every entry needs id (CVE or GHSA), reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails the lane. The 2026-08-29 sweep cleared 15 of the original 17 entries by pinning fixed versions through pnpm.overrides in the root package.json (CLAUDE.md §9). What remains is image-size, which has no fixed release on the registry at all — pnpm audit reports patched_versions '<0.0.0' for both advisories, so there is nothing to bump to.

allow.reason: maplibre-gl (CVE-2026-85061, high/critical): the only patched release is 6.4.1, but apps/web depends on maplibre-gl ^5.24.0 (5.24.0 installed) and the whole 5.x line is vulnerable (advisory range <=6.4.0) with no 5.x fix. The sole fix is a major 5->6 upgrade, which changes the maplibre GL JS API and touches live map UI (apps/web/src/components/ui/map.tsx, config/openui/components/MapBlockView.tsx); it needs its own PR with manual map regression testing, not a mechanical CVE-patch bump folded into an unrelated branch. Client-side map renderer, not a server request path. Re-check / do the v6 upgrade before expiry.

image-size (CVE-2025-71329, JXL/HEIF parser infinite loop, high): NO upstream fix exists — the GitHub advisory reports first_patched_version null over a vulnerable range of <=2.0.2, and 2.0.2 is the latest published release, so every version on the registry is affected. Transitive and pinned by the consumer: apps/mobile > expo > @expo/metro > metro > image-size, where metro@0.83.7 declares image-size ^1.0.2 (1.2.1 installed); image-size 2.x is a breaking major metro's range excludes and is vulnerable anyway. Not reachable from a request path — metro is a build-time bundler, not shipped in the app. Re-check when metro ships a release that drops or replaces image-size.

image-size (CVE-2025-71330, ICNS parser infinite loop, high): NO upstream fix exists — the GitHub advisory reports first_patched_version null over a vulnerable range of <=2.0.2, and 2.0.2 is the latest published release, so every version on the registry is affected. Same consumer and constraint as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: apps/mobile > expo > @expo/metro > metro > image-size, metro@0.83.7 pins ^1.0.2 and image-size 2.x is a breaking major that is itself unpatched. Not reachable from a request path — metro is a build-time bundler, not shipped in the app. Re-check when metro ships a release that drops or replaces image-size.
